hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.py ]]; then python3 -m black "$FILE" --quiet 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if [[ "$FILE" == *.ts || "$FILE" == *.tsx ]]; then npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
N=$(cat loop-logs/.iteration-count 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "[PreCompact] Compacting after iteration $N"
